metadata.description: qmsWrapper end-user documentation authoring with annotated screenshots

plugins.name: tutorial
plugins.description: Turn a feature you have driven, or a module guide, into end-user documentation with annotated screenshots: what the module is for, and how someone doing their job gets each task done. The customer-facing counterpart to the howto skill — same qmsWrapper house style and the same PDF pipeline, but no checkboxes, no defect confirmations and no feedback to send back. Always includes screenshots, annotated to show where to click; always delivers three files: a PDF in the house style, the self-contained HTML it was printed from, and the Markdown source that produced both.
